facts.fact: Finance Permanent Secretary George Guvamatanga said that through ASYCUDA World upgrades ZIMRA has automated customs declarations, reducing paperwork.

The Finance Permanent Secretary said an Electronic Single Window System integrates regulatory agencies in customs clearance, and port health, the National Ozone Unit and the Radiation Protection Authority of Zimbabwe have subscribed to it.

note: The Zimbabwe-Zambia mutual recognition agreement is only said to be at an advanced stage, not data exchange.
